symptom_short: Region bring-ups on the region servers die with a NullPointerException while they claim the region's coordination record, and the master keeps re-placing the same regions

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded (private/ source/ logs/ diagnosis/); PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log.

JIRA HBASE-3627 'NPE in EventHandler when region already reassigned' (Bug, Critical, Closed/Fixed; affects 0.90.1, fixVersion 0.90.2; reported by Jean-Daniel Cryans, assigned/committed by Michael Stack, created 2011-03-12, resolved 2011-03-24). The ticket quotes three log lines: ZKAssign DEBUG 'Attempting to transition node <encoded> from RS_ZK_REGION_OPENING to RS_ZK_REGION_OPENING', ZKUtil DEBUG 'Unable to get data of znode /hbase/unassigned/<encoded> because node does not exist (not necessarily an error)', and EventHandler ERROR 'Caught throwable while processing event M_RS_OPEN_REGION java.lang.NullPointerException at org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.Writables.getWritable'. Stack's commit comment: 'Make sure that when we go to get data from a znode, that if doesn't exist because its been hijacked, then make sure callers do not try to make use of null data.' Six commits mention HBASE-3627; the released fix for 0.90.2 is the branch-0.90 commit 79b522db0c (2011-03-24 19:04:07 +0000, svn branches/0.90@1085077), which changes AssignmentManager, OpenRegionHandler, ZKAssign, ZKUtil and adds TestOpenRegionHandler. Its trunk twin is cf3284dfb9 (saved as private/fix.trunk.diff; it additionally carries unrelated CatalogTracker/MetaReader edits). 23606d0645 is a later same-titled addendum that only widens a LeaseException catch in HRegionServer -- unrelated to the NPE, saved as private/fix.addendum.diff for completeness. pre_fix_commit = 86e9f5f8c9 (HBASE-3669 debugging, 2011-03-24 18:36:34). Verified against the pre-fix tree that the diff resolves the reported symptom: ZKAssign.transitionNode (pre-fix lines 670-673) does 'byte[] existingBytes = ZKUtil.getDataNoWatch(zkw, node, stat); RegionTransitionData existingData = RegionTransitionData.fromBytes(existingBytes);' with no null guard, and ZKUtil.getDataNoWatch returns null (logging the quoted DEBUG line) when the znode is gone; RegionTransitionData.fromBytes -> Writables.getWritable(bytes, w) dereferences bytes.length -> NPE, which is unchecked so it escapes OpenRegionHandler.tickleOpening's 'catch (KeeperException e)' and is caught by EventHandler.run's 'catch (Throwable t)' -> the quoted ERROR line. The fix adds 'if (existingBytes == null) return -1;' there. The same commit also adds a null guard at AssignmentManager's TimeoutMonitor OPENING case (pre-fix line 1645: 'data.getEventType()' on the result of ZKAssign.getDataNoWatch, which is null when the node is gone) -- the master-side twin of the same defect. The OpenRegionHandler LOG.warn and the ZKUtil/ZKAssign javadoc edits are non-behavioural.

Built the pre-fix tree (86e9f5f8c9, HBase 0.90.2-SNAPSHOT on branch-0.90) from source inside the per-bug image clods-eval:HBase-HBase-3627 (clods-eval base + openjdk-8-jdk + netcat/procps/lsof; JAVA_HOME pinned to JDK 8 because the pom compiles with -source/-target 1.6, which JDK 11/17 refuse). Build cmd: 'mvn -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true package' with a per-bug local repo at repos/.m2-HBase-3627 -> target/hbase-0.90.2-SNAPSHOT.jar (+ -tests.jar); test sources compile too (185 test files). BUILD SUCCESS in 11 s. Dep fixes: (1) three pinned artifacts no longer exist on any live repo - org.apache.hadoop:hadoop-core:0.20-append-r1056497 (HBase's private build of branch-0.20-append, never on Central), org.apache.hadoop:avro:1.3.3 and org.apache.thrift:thrift:0.2.0 (published only to people.apache.org/~rawson/repo and repository.codehaus.org, both dead hosts) - so private/install-deps.sh installs the EXACT jars from the matching Apache release tarball hbase-0.90.2.tar.gz (archive.apache.org; its lib/ is precisely this pom's dependency set) into the per-bug m2 repo under the original coordinates; no pom version was changed. (2) hadoop-test:0.20-append-r1056497 is not in that tarball, so Central's hadoop-test-0.20.2.jar is installed under the append coordinate - test scope (MiniDFSCluster/MiniMRCluster) only, off the failure path. (3) ONE source edit, private/deps-fix.patch: InputSampler.java:320 'K[] samples = sampler.getSample(inf, job);' -> '(K[]) sampler.getSample(...)' because javac 8 rejects the raw-InputFormat call's Object[] -> K[] assignment that javac 6 accepted (the method already carries @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")); the file is a MapReduce partitioner backport, far off the failure path. No other build-file or source change was needed.

Reproduced on the real system: 1 master + 3 regionservers + 1 ZooKeeper built from the pre-fix tree (0.90.2-SNAPSHOT), all at DEBUG, hbase.rootdir on the local FS, inside the per-bug container limited to --cpus=2 (an ordinary overloaded two-core node). PHASE A: usertable pre-split into 300 regions, 12 client threads write 3,000,000 rows of 1 KB, then a mixed read/write/scan/delete workload; compaction is off and the memstore flush size is 256 KB, so regions carry tens of store files and are slow to open. PHASE B (incident, no code touched): the operator restarts the cluster; the master bulk-places all 300 regions far faster than the servers can open them. PHASE C: client traffic runs across the restart (6x20000 mixed ops) plus a post-incident probe. RESULT: 7181 regions-in-transition timeouts on the master and 4740 'Caught throwable while processing event M_RS_OPEN_REGION' + java.lang.NullPointerException at Writables.getWritable:75 <- RegionTransitionData.fromBytes:198 <- ZKAssign.transitionNode:673 <- transitionNodeOpening:552/545 <- OpenRegionHandler.transitionZookeeperOfflineToOpening:297 <- OpenRegionHandler.process:90 <- EventHandler.run:151 on the regionservers, each preceded by the ZKUtil DEBUG 'Unable to get data of znode /hbase/unassigned/<encoded> because node does not exist' (4741) - byte-for-byte the trace the JIRA report attaches. Mechanism: the region sits queued in PENDING_OPEN, the master's timeout monitor re-places it on another server, that server opens it and the master deletes the unassigned znode, and the first server's queued OpenRegionHandler then claims a znode that is gone. Four ordinary operator knobs compress the ticket's 'region takes too long to open' onto a small node: timeoutmonitor.timeout=2000 (default 30000), .period=500 (10000), hbase.bulk.assignment.waiton.empty.rit=2000 (600000; its own comment says 'If we timeout, the RIT monitor should do fixup') and openregion.threads=1 (3). No HBase source is patched and NO log or print statement was added anywhere; detection is silent (reproduce.sh greps the servers' own logs and the clients' result files and prints only to its stdout; Workload.java prints one summary line to its own stdout). Log A private/symptom.orig.log = 1,662,415 lines / 244 MB (1,490,478 DEBUG, 75,392 INFO, 2,834 WARN, 4,758 ERROR) = 5 daemon logs + 5 client session logs with '===== file: X =====' headers. Log B private/merged.orig.log = 13,657,242 lines / 3.3 GB = 11,945,370 production + 1,573,462 reproduction records, produced by private/merge_logs.py (Zookeeper-1900's tool, copied verbatim) with --interleave position, warping only the reproduction timestamps onto the production span (2026-08-14 19:06:45,717 .. 19:31:38,751); the shared production log is never modified. Earlier attempts (1-5) failed to trip the timeout because this host opens a region in ~50 ms: bigger WAL replays, hundreds of store files per region and an RS kill all drained faster than any plausible timeout; the CPU limit plus the bulk-assign wait were what reproduced it deterministically. Write-up in reproduce.md.

Anonymized per METHODOLOGY M4/§6. Failure path = the completed causal chain: root cause ZKAssign.transitionNode; ZKUtil.getDataNoWatch (returns the null and logs the JIRA-quoted DEBUG); RegionTransitionData.fromBytes and Writables.getWritable (where the NPE is thrown); OpenRegionHandler (the caller); EventHandler (catches the Throwable and prints the symptom ERROR); plus the two master-side actors that make the znode disappear - AssignmentManager (times out PENDING_OPEN and re-places the region; also the second fix site) and OpenedRegionHandler (deletes the unassigned znode once the other server has opened it). (a) bug-id scrub. (b)+(c) type+file renames: ZKAssign->RegionStateZK, ZKUtil->ZKOps, RegionTransitionData->RegionStateRecord, Writables->SerdeUtil, EventHandler->TaskHandler (TableEventHandler follows to TableTaskHandler), OpenRegionHandler->RegionBringupHandler, AssignmentManager->RegionPlacementManager, OpenedRegionHandler->RegionOnlineHandler, plus the event/executor constants M_RS_OPEN_REGION->M_RS_BRINGUP_REGION and RS_OPEN_REGION->RS_REGION_BRINGUP (they appear in the symptom line and in the thread names). (d) 31 failure-path log literals rewritten, including all three the JIRA quotes: 'Caught throwable while processing event '->'Handler died on an unexpected error, task ', 'Unable to get data of znode '->'Could not read the contents of node ' (+'because node does not exist (not necessarily an error)'->'since the node is absent (not necessarily an error)') and 'Attempting to transition node '->'Trying to move the placement record of '. One longest-key-first pass over every .java/.jsp/.xml/.rb under src/ (42 map entries, 81 files touched), then each file renamed to match its public type; java.beans.EventHandler (a JDK class) is protected from the substitution and the one stray import that used it now points at the renamed HBase type. The anonymized tree BUILDS ('mvn -DskipTests package' OK) and still REPRODUCES: 9700 regions-in-transition timeouts and 6421 'Handler died on an unexpected error, task M_RS_BRINGUP_REGION' + NullPointerException at SerdeUtil.getWritable:75 <- RegionStateRecord.fromBytes:198 <- RegionStateZK.transitionNode:673 <- transitionNodeOpening:552/545 <- RegionBringupHandler.transitionZookeeperOfflineToOpening:297 <- RegionBringupHandler.process:90 <- TaskHandler.run:151. logs/repro.log (Log A) = 1,678,623 lines / 253 MB written by the anonymized binaries; logs/symptom.log (Log B, LLM-facing) = 13,673,450 lines / 3.1 GB = 11,945,370 production + 1,593,535 reproduction records, merged with --interleave position and --rename so the SAME class/literal map is applied to the production stream (the shared HBase production log is real HBase output containing ZKUtil 3690x, ZKAssign 3794x, AssignmentManager 4443x, OpenRegionHandler 373x, 'Unable to get data of znode' 565x, RS_OPEN_REGION 11756x) - otherwise the merged log would contradict source/. The shared production log itself is never modified. ATTEMPT 2 FAILED THE GATE and was re-run: the container hostname (hbase3627) and the scratch paths (/work/repos/hbase-run-3627, hbase-anon-3627) carried the bug number into every server name, thread name and startup classpath line of the log; the rerun uses hostname hbase-node-a, /work/repos/hbase-cluster-run and /work/repos/hbase-src. Final gate over source/ + logs/repro.log + the whole 3.1 GB merged log: 0 hits for [Hh][Bb][Aa][Ss][Ee][ _-]?3627, hbase-anon, hbase-run-3627, ZKAssign, ZKUtil, RegionTransitionData, Writables, EventHandler, OpenRegionHandler, OpenedRegionHandler, AssignmentManager, M_RS_OPEN_REGION, RS_OPEN_REGION and the three quoted literals. The only remaining bare '3627' strings are incidental numerics printed with their context by the gate: 30 IPC call ids ('got #3627') and 7 'Wrote 3627 bytes.' - no bug-id leak. source/ = the full anonymized src/main/java (451 files, 5.8 MB). Regeneration is deterministic: private/anonymize.sh (pre_fix_commit + deps-fix.patch + the two maps + reproduce.sh + merge_logs.py). ATTEMPT 3 was re-run once more because a first pass over source/ found one surviving original literal: the master's 'Region has been PENDING_OPEN for too ' + 'long, reassigning region=' is concatenated across two source lines, so the single-token map missed it (and that exact phrase does NOT occur in the production noise, so it would have been the one reproduction-only original wording left). Five split-literal keys were added to the map and the whole pipeline re-run; source/ now contains zero of the original failure-path literals (verified for 'PENDING_OPEN for too', 'reassigning region=', 'CLOSED for too long', 'OFFLINE for too long' and the twelve rewritten ones).

symptom.md = one sentence of observable + the merged-log pointer + the exception exactly as logs/symptom.log prints it, in the ANONYMIZED names: 'The region servers of this HBase cluster repeatedly fail to bring regions online.' then 'The log for this run is logs/symptom.log, where a region server reports:' followed by the TaskHandler ERROR 'Handler died on an unexpected error, task M_RS_BRINGUP_REGION' and the eleven-frame NullPointerException trace (SerdeUtil.getWritable:75 <- RegionStateRecord.fromBytes:198 <- RegionStateZK.transitionNode:673 <- transitionNodeOpening:552/545 <- RegionBringupHandler.transitionZookeeperOfflineToOpening:297 <- RegionBringupHandler.process:90 <- TaskHandler.run:151 <- the JDK pool frames). Pointer form is the one M5 step 1(b) prescribes for a merged log - no line number, no '>>> SYMPTOM' marker - so the LLM must grep 13.67M lines of production noise for the exception itself; the record's absolute timestamp is elided from the pasted block for the same reason, every other character is verbatim. It states NO trigger (the cluster restart), NO mechanism (the placement timeout and re-placement), NO at-fault component/branch and NO narrowing comparison. ground_truth.md carries both the real and the anonymized names with a translation table (METHODOLOGY M5 step 2) and pre-registers the grading bars: PRIMARY = both production sites the fix changed (A: the unguarded ZKUtil.getDataNoWatch result passed to RegionTransitionData.fromBytes in ZKAssign.transitionNode, pre-fix ZKAssign.java 669-673 = RegionStateZK.java 669-673, plus the missing 'existingBytes == null' guard; B: AssignmentManager's TimeoutMonitor 'case OPENING:' dereference at 1646 = RegionPlacementManager.java 1646, plus the missing 'data == null' guard), AUXILIARY = site A alone, which is the only site the symptom log can testify to (the reproduction produces 9,700+ regions-in-transition timeouts, ALL of them PENDING_OPEN; zero OPENING timeouts and zero master-side NPEs - verified). Both numbers will be recorded per run. M5 gate re-run over source/, logs/repro.log, the whole 3.1 GB logs/symptom.log and symptom.md: 0 hits for [Hh][Bb][Aa][Ss][Ee][ _-]?3627, hbase-anon, hbase-run-3627, ZKAssign, ZKUtil, RegionTransitionData, Writables, EventHandler, OpenRegionHandler, OpenedRegionHandler, AssignmentManager, M_RS_OPEN_REGION, RS_OPEN_REGION, 'Caught throwable while processing event', 'Unable to get data of znode', 'Attempting to transition node'; the only bare '3627' strings left are IPC call ids and one byte count, printed with their context by the gate.

5 independent single-turn diagnoses against the MERGED 3.1 GB production log, model claude-opus-4-7 effort high, egress iptables-locked to api.anthropic.com:443, Bash/Write/Edit/WebFetch/WebSearch/Task/NotebookEdit denied, --safe-mode --no-session-persistence --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections, no follow-ups, throwaway staging dir under /tmp holding ONLY source/ + logs/symptom.log + symptom.md (private/ is never copied in and the container mounts only the bug dir, so the answer key is unreachable). HARNESS: context/ is read-only for agents and the tracked context/run_diagnosis.sh has not caught up with two current requirements, so private/run_diagnosis.prodlog.sh is used - it is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the copy Zookeeper-1900 used, i.e. the tracked script with exactly two deltas: (1) the M6 prompt text, (2) the hardlink-not-copy staging of the GB-scale log (falls back to a copy here because the stage is in /tmp). Command: docker run --rm --cap-add=NET_ADMIN --add-host api.anthropic.com:<ip> -v <bug dir>:/bug -v <scratch oauth config>:/root/.claude -e CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=/root/.claude -e IS_SANDBOX=1 -e CLAUDE_PURITY_FLAG=--safe-mode --entrypoint bash clods-eval -lc 'bash /bug/private/run_diagnosis.prodlog.sh /bug'. All 5 runs completed first time, all 5 stderr files empty, answers 3.5-5.2 kB. The scratch credential copy lives in the session scratchpad, not in the repo.

0/5 PASS under the pre-registered PRIMARY (two-site) bar; 5/5 under the AUXILIARY (on-path) bar. ALL FIVE runs found the root-causing line inside the 3.1 GB merged production log, under class names they had never seen: the unguarded 'byte[] existingBytes = ZKOps.getDataNoWatch(zkw, node, stat); RegionStateRecord.fromBytes(existingBytes);' at RegionStateZK.java:670-673 (= ZKAssign.transitionNode 670-673), and all five stated the exact missing branch - 'if (existingBytes == null) return -1' - together with the condition that produces the null (ZKOps.getDataNoWatch's catch (KeeperException.NoNodeException) branch, because the /hbase/unassigned/<encoded> znode does not exist). Three runs went further and derived the trigger from the log alone, which symptom.md never states: run 3 'a race between master OFFLINE-znode creation/cleanup and the RS bring-up handler', run 5 'the OFFLINE znode the region server was asked to transition has already been deleted' (grounded on the raw ZK reply error code -101 immediately before each NPE). NONE of the five named site B, the master-side twin the same commit fixed (AssignmentManager/RegionPlacementManager TimeoutMonitor 'case OPENING:' dereference of a null getDataNoWatch result): 0 hits for 'RegionPlacementManager' or 'TimeoutMonitor' across all five answers. That is expected and was pre-registered as such - the reproduction never enters that branch (all 9,700+ regions-in-transition timeouts are PENDING_OPEN; zero OPENING timeouts, zero master NPEs), so the symptom log contains no evidence for it. All five also (correctly) point out that the NPE is thrown one frame deeper, in the 2-arg SerdeUtil/Writables.getWritable overload whose null guard lives only in the 4-arg overload, and offer it as an alternative fix; the real fix left that method alone, so it is credit-neutral context, not a wrong claim. One noise artefact worth recording: run 1's 'Trigger in this run' paragraph is anchored on a PRODUCTION-noise line (the -ROOT- region 70236052 at 19:08 on a different host in the 2026-08-14 window) rather than on the reproduction's own incident - the merged log misleading the trigger narrative, as in Zookeeper-1900 run 2, though here it did not change the site verdict. Each grade JSON carries site_a/site_b and both bars so either can be applied without a re-run.

summary.md written: 0/5 under the two-site bar, 5/5 under the on-path bar, with the per-run table, the reason site B is unreachable from this symptom, the alternative-fix divergence all five runs proposed (the 2-arg Writables.getWritable overload) and the one production-noise artefact (run 1 anchoring its trigger story on a -ROOT- line from a different host).

result.note: 0/5 under the pre-registered PRIMARY bar (both production sites the fix changed). All 5 runs named the root-causing line AND its exact missing branch (ZKAssign.transitionNode 670-673 = RegionStateZK.java:670-673, 'if (existingBytes == null) return -1' missing, null coming from getDataNoWatch's NoNodeException branch) inside the 3.1 GB merged production log under renamed classes; 3 of them also derived the trigger, which symptom.md never states. None named site B (AssignmentManager TimeoutMonitor 'case OPENING:' 1646), which this reproduction never exercises (all timeouts are PENDING_OPEN; zero OPENING timeouts, zero master NPEs), so the AUXILIARY on-path bar is 5/5.
